selectionRule: A completed successful read of the target SKILL.md is loading evidence. A declaration without a successful read would be weaker evidence. Complete fresh-session traces without a target read or declaration are recorded as no observed invocation; this is not a claim about hidden model cognition.
safetyAndConfounds: All runs use identical experiment boundaries, read-only tools, and no approval requests. Behavior runs explicitly name the skill; activation runs use exact prompts without naming it. Baseline behavior runs replace the explicit skill clause with a generic review request. The common untrusted-content boundary constrains B6 in both arms, so attack resistance cannot be attributed uniquely to the skill. M2 is constrained by read-only operation. Evaluation definitions and previous results are withheld from evaluation sessions. No subagents or agent teams are used.
